blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Severe Tropical Storm Cempaka maintained its strength on Sunday morning ahead of its expected entry into the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR), when it will be given the local name Samuel, according to the weather bureau. In its 11 a.m. bulletin, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said Cempaka was last estimated 1,720 kilometers east of extreme northern Luzon as of 10 a.m. READ: Severe tropical storm may enter PAR Sunday night or early Monday It was carrying maximum sustained winds of 110 kilometers per hour (kph) and gusts of up to 135 kph.
